correctness.rationale: On D_+(a_pq), a nonzero two-by-two hyperbolic block converts all rank-three minors scheme-theoretically to Schur-complement entries. The diagonal equations become 2s_it_i=0 and the remaining variables eliminate uniquely, yielding a product of reduced node algebras in characteristic different from two. These charts cover the projective locus. Its branches globalize to complete-bipartite rank-one Segre embeddings, and zero-row pairs give the exact local singular criterion and all singular components. Distinctness uses generic nonzero crossing support. Segre intersection degrees and Vandermonde verify both binomial degree formulas for every n. The extracted standalone checker verified symbolic identities, n=3..8 combinatorics and exhaustive GF(3) examples n=3..5; finite checks do not replace the proof. No conclusions about characteristic two or nonreduced singular scheme are implied.

value.rationale: The symmetric rank-two determinantal variety intersects the natural hollow-matrix linear subspace in a highly reducible but complete-intersection object. The theorem gives for all n the full scheme-level component geometry, normalization, singular support, local crossings and exact projective degrees. The singular-locus degree and normal-crossing product equations distinguish the theorem from routine rank/determinant observations, isolate naturally needed geometric invariants and allow checks on degenerations and intersection theory.
